title: Day, Week and Timeline calendar views exist
detail:
The three views are a label plus a Coming soon mark; Google, Apple, Outlook and Notion sync are four rows with no button. Calendar redesign plan lives in /mnt/project-files/calendar/.

CLOSED 2026-10-26 by LIVE-1178 (ADR-1876): the three views are built. The other half of the original title, a connect button for Google, Apple, Outlook and Notion two-way sync, is split into LIVE-1179: it needs provider credentials and the owner's go (calendar plan phase 12), so it is not hidden inside this closure.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
